title: Gen-DM
fill_note: DENSE layered wind with a jig; scorer cap 0.65
fill_how: The scored turns assume a dense, layer-by-layer wind at fill 0.65 (insulated-wire area / window; the scorer cap). Use a winding jig on a drill/lathe with a turn counter, lay each layer side-by-side with light back-tension, and do not scramble-wind: a scramble wind only reaches ≈0.55–0.60 and then the window holds fewer turns (scorer what-if `--fill 0.60` is in the table above). Never wind more than the listed turns — the copper must stay below the flanges.
steel_extra: **New steel:** Ø264 discs, M3 clamp map R30 at 0/90/180/270° and R44 on the inter-pole angles 67.5/112.5/247.5/292.5° (both inside the R95.5 magnet ring). Cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf`; no earlier disc fits.
o5_note: 48 O5x5 used as AXIAL POLE EXTENDERS, 3 per pole per rotor (pair flanking the N42 block at R112.3 ±13.65 mm + 1 at R81.85 inside the O20), same polarity as the pole — NOT Halbach assists (no inter-pole Ø5). AXIAL O5: stand upright. DIAMETRIC O5: lay on its side (axis tangential) with the pole-letter side up — both fit the 5.3 mm square pocket; the scorer counts them either way (upright scored, lying what-if within 0.05 %).
card_title: Gen-DM · 8p/12c · axial-Ø5 triple pole at R95.5 · ARC UPGRADE on the Gen-DG/DJ stator + Ø264 steel · 24 AWG
card_sub: Ø20 @R95.5 + N42 @R111.1 + N52 bar @R121.7 + 3 axial Ø5/pole · Gen-DG/DJ bobbins r74–134 × 4.4 × 18.6 mm (223 t) · 7.00 mm gap · 2× Ø264 steel (Gen-DG/DJ discs, clamp holes R95) · 2026-10-27
idea: Gen-DJ's pole moved out 0.5 mm (R95 -> R95.5, the flat top of scans j3/j4) while keeping the Gen-DG/DJ Ø264 steel-disc hole map (clamp bolts stay at R95 ±13°) and the identical 8-layer stator: a Gen-DG or Gen-DJ owner prints only 16 new arcs. Scans j1-j4 (365 combos) re-searched the Ø5 placement (13 printable sites), 6/7/8/9 layers and the stator window: the Gen-DJ family is converged — this is the best printable point, a small honest gain.
steel_note: Steel: 2× Ø264 × 4.76 mm (3/16") mild-steel discs, clamp map hub M3 at R22 0/90/180/270°, 4× Ø4.3 brace holes R18 at 45/135/225/315°, 16 arc-clamp M3 at R95 ±13° from every pole, index notch at +X — cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf` (laser-cut service, or any shop that cuts 3/16" mild steel). Lobed arcs: 2.4 mm PLA around each pocket; the epoxy-to-steel bond, not the PLA, holds the magnets. **Same discs as Gen-DG / Gen-DJ** (identical OD and hole map — clamp bolts deliberately kept at R95 while the pole moved to R95.5) — a Gen-DG/DJ owner re-uses them.
retro_md:
## Modular notes (Gen-DM)

Full kit, and at the same time a **print-only rotor-arc upgrade for Gen-DG or Gen-DJ**: the stator, bobbins (223 t), 7.00 mm gap sleeve, hubs, shaft, collars, bearing bridges, standoffs and the Ø264 steel discs are geometry-identical to Gen-DG/DJ (same parameters; clamp-bolt circle kept at R95). An owner prints only `rotor_arc_n.stl` ×8 + `rotor_arc_s.stl` ×8 and moves the Ø20 discs, N42 blocks, N52 bars and the 48 Ø5 into the new arcs (every magnet lands 0.5 mm further out). **Honest size of the gain:** ≈ +0.2 % over Gen-DJ — only worth it if you are rebuilding the arcs anyway. **Moving magnets from old arcs:** the magnets are epoxied to the steel through the arc pockets. Unbolt the old arcs, then release each magnet with a thin non-magnetic (brass/plastic) wedge or a hot-air gun at ≤ 70 °C on the steel (N52 loses strength above ≈80 °C — never heat the magnets directly), scrape the old epoxy off the steel, and keep released magnets in a padded box far apart. If that is too risky, buy a second pair of discs from the DXF. Swap stators/rotors with the 4 temporary M4 jack rods: raise rotor B on the nuts (clap hazard in reverse, never by hand), swap the part, lower rotor B, remove the rods.
halb_block:
halbach_magnetisation = "none";  // NO inter-pole Halbach O5 in this kit: all 48 O5x5 are AXIAL POLE EXTENDERS (pole_o5_*)
rotor_b_same_axis   = true;     // same-index magnets share one axis: N faces S across the gap
small_block:
small_r_list        = [];       // no O5 pockets
// --- N42 rectangular BLOCK magnets (2026-10-16/18): one 20x10x5 block per pole on the pole angle, next to the O20 disc ---
block_R_list        = [111.1];   // block centre radius (pole angle); same polarity as its O20 -> radially extended pole (scorer position = pushed-apart magnet centre)
block_angle_list    = [0];
block_radial        = 10.0;    // block side that runs RADIALLY (mm)
block_tangential    = 20.0;    // block side that runs TANGENTIALLY (mm)
block_h             = 5.0;     // magnetised through the 5 mm thickness (axial), = magnet_h_large so it sits on the steel
block_Br            = 1.29;    // N42 remanence (1.28-1.32 T); scorer models it as a magpylib Cuboid
block_pocket_clear  = 0.3;    // pocket = block + 0.3 mm each way (+ 1.2 mm corner reliefs)
keyhole_pocket      = true;     // 2026-10-18: disc + block share ONE keyhole pocket (hull); they repel onto the far walls
disc_pocket_shift   = 0.00;    // disc pocket centre offset (radial) so the pushed-apart disc sits at R_large
block_pocket_shift  = -0.15;    // block pocket centre offset so the pushed-apart block sits at block_R_list (scorer position)
// --- N52 60x10x3 BARS (2026-10-21, physics_scorer block2 group): one per pole, OUTSIDE the O20, 60 mm side TANGENTIAL ---
block2_R_list       = [121.7];   // bar centre radius (pushed onto the outer pocket wall by its disc)
block2_angle_list   = [0];
block2_radial       = 10.0;     // bar 10 mm side radial
block2_tangential   = 60.0;     // bar 60 mm side tangential
block2_h            = 3.0;      // magnetised through the 3 mm thickness (axial); gap face FLUSH with the disc face
block2_Br           = 1.43;     // N52
block2_pocket_clear = 0.3;
block2_pocket_depth = 3.05;     // BLIND pocket from the stator face: bar sits on a 1.95 mm PLA floor over the steel
block2_pocket_shift = -0.15;    // pocket centre -0.15 -> outer wall at R + 5.0 (pushed-out bar sits exactly at block2_R_list)
block2_merge_in     = 0.45;     // pocket inner wall extended inward so it opens into the disc pocket (no PLA sliver)
eng_a = 4.6; eng_L = 5.0; eng_ta = 4.6; eng_tr = 0;   // engraving: N/S pole letter on the spine (no Halbach arrows; 2026-10-26 axial O5)
// --- O5x5 AXIAL POLE EXTENDERS (2026-10-26, physics_scorer pole_o5 group): 3 per pole, same polarity as the pole's disc ---
pole_o5_R_list      = [113.127, 113.127, 81.850];   // centre radius of each O5 (pole frame)
pole_o5_angle_list  = [6.9303, -6.9303, 0.0000];   // angle offset from the pole (deg)
pole_o5_mode        = "upright";   // scored as UPRIGHT axial O5x5 (lying diametric O5 scored as a what-if: within 0.05 %)
pole_o5_d           = 5.0;
pole_o5_h           = 5.0;
pole_o5_pocket      = 5.3;      // SQUARE through-pocket 5.3 x 5.3 (fits an upright O5x5 OR one lying on its side), 1.2 mm corner reliefs
